title: Preventing Adversarial Use of Datasets through Fair Core-Set Construction
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not conduct any benchmarks related to faith or religion.
findings: The paper does not analyze, mention, or have any findings related to religion or faith. Its focus is on data privacy and security through the construction of dataset subsets called core-sets.
